description: Hero case. Debian 12 whose sources.list has no bookworm-security entry, so php8.2 is stuck at 8.2.32-1~deb12u1 while the fix sits in 8.2.35-1~deb12u1. The upstream version 8.2.32 is below upstream's 8.2.35 too, so this one is genuinely affected, and the remediation is to enable bookworm-security and upgrade.
stack: Debian 12 bookworm, nginx with php8.2-fpm, sources.list without the security pocket
why: OSV: Debian:12 php8.2 8.2.32-1~deb12u1 still affected; fixed in 8.2.35-1~deb12u1 via bookworm-security.
